about-hero: Practitioner holding a cold-laser probe to a seated woman's shoulder while supporting her arm, with a glowing overlay of the arm and shoulder bones and a red glow at the shoulder joint.
about-drvw-learning: Study desk in the clinic with a model spine, a stack of textbooks, an open notebook with reading glasses and a cup of coffee.
ak-roof: Practitioner's hand on a seated man's shoulder, with a glowing overlay of the neck and shoulder and a red glow at the top of the shoulder.
ak-mtest: Manual muscle test: the practitioner presses down on a seated woman's outstretched arm, with a glowing overlay of the arm and shoulder muscles and a red glow at the shoulder.
ak-balance: Engraving-style illustration of a two-pan balance scale, level.
ak-chain: Engraving-style illustration of a chain with one larger link in the middle.
ak-legit-hero: Manual muscle test: the practitioner's flat hand presses on a lying patient's raised forearm while he steadies her elbow; the forearm muscles glow, with red at the muscle being tested.
ak-who-imaging: A patient hands an X-ray of the lower spine across a table to the practitioner.
book-hero: Front desk by a window with a white desk telephone, an open appointment book and pen, and a sprig of eucalyptus, the treatment room behind.
cond-auto-assess: Practitioner's hand on the upper back of a seated man, with a glowing overlay of the neck, spine and shoulder blades and a red glow at the base of the neck.
cond-auto-hero: Engraving-style illustration of the seven neck vertebrae in side view, with concentric rings at mid-neck marking a whiplash impact.
cond-auto-treat: Man lying face down while a stand-mounted laser shines three red lines on his upper back, with a glowing overlay of the spine and shoulder blade and a red glow at the base of the neck.
cond-carpal-assess: Engraving-style illustration of the arm from neck to fingertips, tracing the median nerve from the neck, past the shoulder and down the arm into the hand.
cond-carpal-hero: Engraving-style illustration of the hand and wrist bones, with the median nerve passing under the ligament band at the wrist and branching into the thumb and first fingers.
cond-carpal-treat: Handheld cold-laser probe shining on the wrist of a patient's outstretched hand, with a glowing overlay of the hand bones and nerve and a red glow at the carpal tunnel.
cond-fibro-assess: Practitioner's hands resting on a seated woman's shoulders, with a glowing overlay of the spine and back muscles and several small red tender points.
cond-fibro-hero: Engraving-style illustration of the human body from behind, with small dots marking the classic fibromyalgia tender points.
cond-fibro-treat: Woman lying face down while the practitioner uses a small adjusting instrument beside her upper spine, with a glowing overlay of the spine and shoulder blades and red tender points.
cond-frozen-assess: Practitioner holding a seated woman's arm out to the side while feeling her shoulder blade, with a glowing overlay of the shoulder and arm bones and a red glow at the shoulder joint.
cond-frozen-hero: Engraving-style illustration of the shoulder joint, with a dotted arc showing the arm's full range and a short solid arc showing the limited range of a frozen shoulder.
cond-frozen-treat: Practitioner steadying a seated woman's shoulder and supporting her outstretched arm, with a glowing overlay of the shoulder and arm bones and a red glow at the shoulder joint.
cond-headache-assess: Practitioner's fingertips at the base of a seated woman's skull, with a glowing overlay of the neck vertebrae and a red glow at the upper neck.
cond-headache-hero: Engraving-style illustration of the skull and neck vertebrae in side view.
cond-headache-treat: Handheld cold-laser probe at the base of a seated woman's skull, with a glowing overlay of the neck and a red glow at the top of the neck.
cond-lbp-assess: Straight-leg-raise test: the practitioner lifts a man's leg as he lies on his back, with a glowing overlay of the lower spine, pelvis and thigh bone and a red glow at the lower back.
cond-lbp-hero: Engraving-style illustration of the five lumbar vertebrae and the sacrum in side view.
cond-lbp-treat: Man lying face down while a stand-mounted laser shines three red lines on his lower back, with a glowing overlay of the lower spine and pelvis and a red glow at the lowest vertebrae.
cond-oa-assess: Practitioner kneeling beside a man in a shallow squat and feeling the outside of his knee, with a glowing overlay of the knee joint and a red glow at the knee.
cond-oa-hero: Engraving-style illustration of the knee joint from the front, showing the thigh bone, shin bone, kneecap and the ligament between them.
cond-oa-treat: Man seated on the table with legs out straight while a stand-mounted laser shines red lines on his knee, with a glowing overlay of the leg bones and a red glow at the knee joint.
cond-osteo-assess: Older woman balancing on one foot, holding the table edge, the practitioner ready to steady her; a glowing overlay of the spine and hip with red glows at the mid back and hip.
cond-osteo-hero: Engraving-style illustration of two thigh bones side by side, the one on the right with a sparser inner lattice, showing bone loss.
cond-osteo-treat: Older woman lying face down while the practitioner applies a small adjusting instrument to her mid back, with a glowing overlay of the spine and inner ribs and a red glow at the mid back.
cond-pinched-assess: Practitioner testing the reflex at the elbow of a man lying on the table, with a glowing overlay of the nerve running from his neck down the arm and a red glow where it leaves the neck.
cond-pinched-hero: Engraving-style illustration of two vertebrae in side view, with a bulging disc pressing on a nerve root where it leaves the spine.
cond-pinched-treat: Man lying face down with a ring-shaped PEMF coil resting on his upper back, cabled to a console, with a glowing overlay of the spine and a red glow at the base of the neck.
cond-plantar-treat: Stand-mounted laser shining three red lines on the heel of a bare foot resting on a towel, with a glowing overlay of the foot bones and a red glow under the heel.
cond-pregnancy-treat: Pregnant woman seated on the treatment table, the practitioner's hands on her lower back, with a glowing side view of the lower spine and pelvis and a red glow at the sacroiliac joint.
cond-sciatica-treat: Man lying face down while the practitioner holds a laser probe over his buttock, with a glowing overlay of the pelvis and the sciatic nerve down the leg and a red glow at the buttock.
cond-scoliosis-treat: Woman lying face down while the practitioner's hands rest either side of her spine, with a glowing overlay of a gently curved spine and a red glow along the muscles on one side.
cond-shoulder-treat: Practitioner working along the edge of a seated man's shoulder blade, with a glowing overlay of the shoulder blade and rotator cuff and a red glow at the top of the shoulder.
cond-disc-treat: Man lying face down with a ring-shaped PEMF coil on his lower back, cabled to a console, with a glowing overlay of the spine and a red glow at the lowest lumbar disc.
cond-stress-treat: Practitioner's thumbs pressing into the tops of a face-down woman's shoulders, with a glowing overlay of the neck and upper back muscles and red glows at the base of the neck.
cond-tennis-treat: Handheld cold-laser probe at the outer elbow of a man lying on the table with his arm on a towel, with a glowing overlay of the elbow and forearm and a red glow at the outer elbow.
cond-neck-treat: Practitioner's stacked hands on the upper back of a woman lying face down, with a glowing overlay of the spine and shoulder blades and a red glow between the shoulder blades.
cond-whiplash-treat: Practitioner's hands on either side of the neck of a woman lying face down, with a glowing overlay of the neck vertebrae and a red glow along the neck muscles.
cond-work-treat: Man in work clothes squatting to lift a box while the practitioner guides his lower back, with a glowing overlay of the lower spine and pelvis and a red glow at the lower back.
pi-faq-hero: Patient and practitioner talking across a small round table with cups of tea and a notebook, the clinic behind them.
pi-first-bring: What to bring to a first visit: an X-ray in its envelope, a medication list, a pill organiser, medicine boxes, an intake form on a clipboard, and reading glasses.
pi-first-hero: Practitioner with a clipboard talking with a seated man at his first visit, with a glowing overlay of his spine and a red glow at the lower back.
pi-forms-hero: Blank intake form on a clipboard with a pen on the front counter, next to a desk telephone.
svc-hub-hero: The treatment room: a padded adjusting table, a stand-mounted laser on its arm, and a ring-shaped PEMF coil with its console on a side table.
svc-cold-hero: Handheld cold-laser probe at the inner knee of a woman sitting on the treatment table, with a glowing overlay of the knee joint and a red glow at the joint.
svc-fx635-device: Stand-mounted low-level laser shining three red lines onto a patient's heel, with a glowing overlay of the foot bones and a red glow under the heel.

cond-carpal-hero-alternative: Engraving-style illustration of the hand and wrist bones seen side-on, with a ligament band across the wrist and the median nerve passing under it into the thumb and fingers.
